text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeaaah!! Alright, let's gooo!!
Oi, oi, oooiiiii!!
choice_data_list: You're crazy fired up, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Huuuh? Whatcha talkin' about, foo!
The Golshi floor is always totally hyped up, y'all, aww yeah!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Don't bother servin' me any borin' menu items, though.
You'd better match my mood to a T!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
By the way, if you dare give me
a boring workout menu...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Today's training is
'Golshi's Rapid-River Trainer Rafting'!!
...Valuing my life, I decided to choose from the menu just as Gold Ship told me to.
